answer: PoA resists sybils by requiring every identity to lock bonded collateral in an escrow. If k identities equivocate on correlated claims, their penalty scales as O(k^2), not linearly; detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making swarm control economically self-defeating. Telemetry fields named raven, willow, and inlet record shared-key, timing, or funding links, so attribution triggers asymmetric depreciation and slashing.
